stories.title: Explosion hits Russian corvette in Benghazi port, suspected drone attack
stories.summary: An explosion hit a Russian navy Project 20380 Steregushchiy‑class corvette, identified as the Merkury, while it was docked for fuel and supplies at the Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya on Sunday morning. Libya’s eastern government said the blast was caused by a suspected drone attack. Satellite and high‑resolution imagery later showed the vessel capsized, with only its forward bow remaining above water, and a nearby commercial ship also suffered minor injuries.
stories.why: It demonstrates the extension of conflict risks to foreign military and commercial vessels operating in Libyan waters.

stories.title: India, EU likely to sign free‑trade agreement on Dec 16
stories.summary: India and the 27‑member European Union are expected to sign their free‑trade agreement on 16 December, an Indian official said. Negotiations were concluded on 27 January this year, and the pact would give duty‑free access to the EU for roughly 93 % of Indian exports while lowering tariffs on luxury cars and wines from the bloc.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
